messages.subject: Re: R was not built as a shared library - cents 6
messages.subject_clean: R was not built as a shared library - cents 6
messages.body_plain:
On Monday, June 4, 2012 5:59:27 PM UTC+2, bbolt wrote:
> Hi,
> I am trying install rapache on centos 6 and am running into this error
> (which I understand is common):
> ------------
> R was not built as a shared library
>
> Either build it with one, or use another install of R
> --------------

I had this problem as well today on Fedora 20. The problem turned out to be that 'make' was not installed. Therefore in configure, the line:

R CMD config --ldflags

fails, unfortunately with the wrong error message. Simply installing make solved the problem in my case.

messages.subject: RApache rpm packages for Fedora/CentOS/RHEL
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I finally got around creating rapache rpm installation packages for Fedora, CentOS and RHEL. I think this should be the preferable way to install rapache on these systems because it automatically deals with dependencies, configuration files, SELinux, etc. The package has been tested on Fedora 20 and CentOS 6, but I assume it should work on most recent enterprise Linux versions.

Spec file and build instructions are available here: https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/rapache/tree/master/rpm#readme. Please let me know if you decide to give this a try, and if you can or cannot get things to work.

Jeroen
